quest.title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Experimental Procedure
quest.description: Hosseini has finally figured out how to get the Pursina's Spike into the depths of the mines...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After the Pursina's Spike has been moved to the tunnel depths, Hosseini arrives at the site of the rupture.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Well, the Spike has finally been placed.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: *cough* According to my estimations, this should be the opening through which the Ley Lines are overflowing.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: If we can get the Spike up and running here, we can affect the Ley Lines such that the opening can be closed...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I believe that this will solve our problem for good.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: No, we cannot. I must perform another round of checks. We cannot afford to have another problem like the one we faced during the test run.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Once the Spike is ready, we will be rid of this terrible mud and the monsters that come with it... *cough*
